items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: She said, that's Johnny Deidre. That's my old friend.

ctx.x: Then he gives me a $100 tip.

And I took it, a $100 bail, I took it, it was a show with my pie. But he had to tell me that I was ornery. When I broadcast for posters on WDSU, I forget, I'm so seldom I have a broadcast. I couldn't get a mix, I couldn't get a test. Every time we were trying to tune up, I said, shh, somebody, I said, well, what are going to do, I'm going to do a broadcast after one, I don't even see a microphone. Because I had music go for 26 weeks and I would set it up myself. I'd see that everything was set to go over the air.…
And he took her on and walked off.
